entry.title: Anshun Bridge

groundCutout.basis: The intersection of the mapped bridge deck and Jinjiang water polygon removes the deck’s draped paving from the channel while retaining the bank approaches.

entry.note: Three stone vaults and two pier oculi carry a raised timber gallery. Dark sweeping roofs crown the red columns and stepped side pavilions. Pale railings follow the two walkways from the stair landings to the central hall. The 492 m sea-level datum is aligned to standard viewer terrain and river geometry. Four modeled stair runs join the two paths to the rendered bank approaches. Replacement is limited to the deck outline and retains the surrounding paths, banks and river. A river-only paving cutout clears the draped deck area beneath the stone vaults. Preview places the authored base at the recorded absolute sea-level elevation; local tide and terrain resolution remain host-dependent.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
